prerequisites: No reducible-spending evidence was supplied; evidence of at least 9000.00 in sufficient discretionary expenses before the deadline is required.
A reforecast and authorization are required after the reductions are evidenced.
Verified reducible spending must cover the required amount before the deadline
plans.explanation: This option is conditional on evidence that sufficient discretionary expenses can be reduced by the deadline. The supplied buffer is 0.00 and adds no funding.
